Welcome to a journey that’s more than just history—it's a story of courage, resilience, and the relentless search for freedom. Imagine what it must have felt like to be Harriet Tubman, born into slavery, facing a world divided by hope and despair. Her life wasn’t just about surviving—it was about daring to change her fate, and then risking everything to help others do the same.
As we explore together, we’ll feel the weight of those choices and the power of Tubman’s determination. Her legacy reminds us just how much strength one person can carry, even when the odds seem impossible.
Beverly Lowry, in her compelling portrayal of Tubman’s life, invites us to see beyond the surface—to understand the fear, the ingenuity, and the compassion that shaped each step along the Underground Railroad. We’ll walk through the shadows of oppression, but also into the light of possibility that Tubman herself helped create.
So, let’s set out on this adventure together. We’re about to uncover the remarkable path Harriet Tubman carved, and discover just how her story continues to inspire hope and courage in all of us.
